scope: Isolated candidate module executed by Node.js with injected backend responses, in-memory cache and simulated clock; not the existing publicRule handler
missingMeaning: Successful empty query result in the caller's visibility context, not proof of global nonexistence

negativeControl.mutation: Treat HTTP failure as missing and negatively cache it

verifiedLocally: Positive TTL 30 seconds and negative TTL 15 seconds
HTTP, transport and payload failures are not negatively cached
Immediate retry after simulated backend recovery
Fresh mode bypasses local cache reads and writes
Fresh denied or empty response does not return stale cached redirect
Cache I/O failure does not invent backend absence
Hostname validation, namespace isolation and rule field whitelist
freshLimit: Does not delete or update existing entries; a later non-fresh lookup may still return an older cached rule. The no-store option is a hint passed to the injected adapter, not proof of upstream freshness.
limits: No actual Supabase/PostgREST adapter or RLS verification
No native Worker or Cloudflare Cache API execution
No browser, provider, DNS, TLS or alias tenant-identity verification
No global invalidation, timeout or concurrency guarantee
No merge, deployment, environment flag activation or production mutation
